title: WoDX Otherworlds
description: World of Darkness Expanded: Gauntlet, Shroud and Banality ratings; stepping sideways by the era's rules; Penumbra and Shadowlands twin levels, crossing the Shroud, Disconnection, Umbral paths, Read the Soul, Otherworld journeys through the Tempest, the Labyrinth and the Umbral roads (seeded, through the approval queue), and the Shadowlands' decay on the map by the local Shroud, the Near Dreaming's shimmer and the Net's glowing lines. Ways and realms: deep realms as scenes of their own, with drawn maps for every realm past the near worlds, and generated town maps reflected in the Penumbra and Shadowlands, and trods, Moon Paths, airts, Anchorheads and Byways as regions that carry a token between places. Private use only; not for distribution or sale.

recommends.reason: Picks the Gauntlet chart from the era in force, and holds the approval queue. It must be installed even when it is off: WoDX Otherworlds uses its search box and its map generator files.
